description: The pie chart, labeled "(b) P6: Matching statistics," illustrates the distribution of matching frequencies for Persona 6 across seven distinct categories. The chart is divided into seven slices, which are arranged sequentially by their numerical labels in a clockwise descending order from 6 to 0, rather than by size. The top slice, colored blue and labeled "6 Matches", is the largest, accounting for 27.2% (8006). Moving clockwise, the next slice is light blue, labeled "5", representing 10.4% (3043). The following slice is pale blue, labeled "4", making up 6.2% (1810). Next is a light green slice labeled "3" at 6.8% (2002). Continuing clockwise, a pale yellow slice labeled "2" accounts for 22.4% (6583). A beige slice labeled "1" represents 13.8% (4046). Finally, a light orange slice labeled "0" makes up 13.3% (3910). The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, category labels are positioned just outside the perimeter of their respective slices. Both the percentage and the raw count (enclosed in parentheses) are displayed directly inside each slice, and no individual segments are visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding.
